name: institute.intex/latex-accessibility
title: Intex: LaTeX accessibility
description: LaTeX in; tagged PDFs, web pages with MathML, WCAG 2.1 reports and spoken formulas out.

tools.name: read_formula
tools.description: One LaTeX formula in (math mode, no dollar signs). Back come what it reads as, the words a screen reader says for it, the text it copies out as, and its MathML. Free without a key, thirty formulas every ten minutes; with a key, a tenth of a cent each.

tex.description: The formula, for example \frac{a}{b} or e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0.

tools.name: count_project
tools.description: A LaTeX project in. Its pages, formulas, figures and tables out, with what each tool would cost for it, in cents. Free, with a key. Up to 24 MB for the project. A project that cannot be built costs nothing; the answer gives the file and line.

files.description: The project's text files by their path inside the project, each file's whole text: the .tex files, and any .bib, .bbl, .sty, .cls or .tikz of your own. Example: {"main.tex": "\\documentclass{article}...", "chapters/one.tex": "..."}.

binary_files.description: Figures and other binary files by path, each base64-encoded. PNG and JPEG are placed as they are; a PDF, EPS or SVG figure is answered with its name, to be saved as a PNG.

archive.description: Instead of files: the whole project as one .zip or .tar.gz, base64-encoded.

main.description: The path of the main .tex file. Needed only when the project has more than one.
